notes: Facts concern the Bioengineering BSc programme. durationYears: 7 semesters = 3.5 years. teachingLanguages: English only. tuition: DAAD page states 'Tuition fees per semester None' for the programme (state university in NRW); the university's 'Living costs in Germany' page also says no tuition fees are charged, but that is an institution-wide statement. No intake dates with day/month/year are stated for this programme; only the winter semester and 15 July deadline (deadline quoted on the DAAD page without a year, therefore left null). applicationChannel: the programme page states foreign-qualification applicants should register on hochschulstart.de and then apply via uni-assist; the DAAD page says 'Please apply via uni-assist'. No explicit VPD (Vorprüfungsdokumentation) is mentioned, so de-uni-assist chosen. documents: only the enrolment document list quoted from the Bachelor's degrees page; no translation requirement is stated for the named document. English proficiency is quoted as an admission requirement (B2 + official certificate); the DAAD page lists accepted tests (IELTS Academic 5.5, TOEFL iBT). German is not required.

evidence.quote: TOEFL iBT (since 2026): 4 Reading: 4 Listening: 4 Speaking: 4 Writing: 4
English language proficiency (Certificate of Level B2 according to the Common European Framework (CEF)), as the programme is taught entirely in English.
